title: Animals in different homes
examples: What kind of animals live in the rainforest?
Does the ocean have different animal homes?

explain.say: Today we learn about animal homes. We call these homes habitats. Every animal needs a special place to live.
The desert is a very dry place. Camels are animals that live well in the desert.
The Arctic is very cold and icy. Polar bears are strong animals that live in the Arctic.
The rainforest is warm and wet. Monkeys swing through the trees in the rainforest.
The ocean is a huge body of salt water. Whales swim deep in the ocean.
Look at the different homes. Some animals need dry land, others need cold ice.

faq.q: Do all animals live in one kind of home?
faq.a: No, animals live in many different kinds of homes. Some live on land, and some live in water.

faq.q: What is the difference between a desert and a rainforest?
faq.a: The desert is very dry with little water. The rainforest is very wet with lots of plants.
asks: What is the opposite of a desert?

faq.q: Do animals move between these habitats?
faq.a: Some animals do move between habitats. They might move when the food changes.
asks: Can polar bears leave the Arctic?

faq.q: Are all oceans the same for animals?
faq.a: No, some parts of the ocean are very deep. Other parts are near the sunny surface.
asks: What lives deep in the sea?

faq.a: A habitat is simply the natural home or environment where an animal or plant lives.

facts: Deserts are characterized by very little rainfall.
The Arctic is known for its ice and very low temperatures.
Rainforests have high levels of rainfall and plant life.
The ocean is a vast body of saltwater.

quiz.say: A monkey lives in which place?
quiz.why: Monkeys are usually found in warm, wet areas with many trees.

wrong.0: Monkeys are land animals, not ocean swimmers.
wrong.2: Deserts are too dry for monkeys to find enough food.
wrong.3: The Arctic is too cold for monkeys to survive there.

quiz.say: Which animal belongs in the Arctic?
quiz.why: Polar bears are adapted to live on ice and in very cold environments.

wrong.0: Whales live in the ocean, not on ice sheets.
wrong.3: Camels live in dry deserts, not icy poles.

quiz.say: If an animal needs very little water, where might it live?
quiz.why: The desert is the habitat known for its lack of water.

wrong.1: Rainforests are known for having lots of water and rain.
wrong.2: The Arctic is cold, but the desert is defined by dryness.
wrong.3: The ocean is water, but the desert is a land type.
